name: com.prenominal.realtimecsg
description: Realtime-CSG is a CSG level design tool, that allows you to intuitively and rapidly create levels. With its non-destructive workflow, you can easily adjust your levels at any time, and iterate with instant feedback.

author.name: Sander van Rossen (LogicalError), Contributions by Lindsey (NukeAndBeans, Kerfuffles), OverBridges (Levi), SamNChiet (SamPerson), Kolton Meier (Janooba), Eideren, and Gawi.
